title: •Blizzard 1
caption: •Blizzard 1 (V)
game_text: May add 2 pilots and 8 passengers. During the power segment of a battle here, may lose X cards from hand to cause +X attrition against opponent. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: General Veers’ AT-AT. *Enclosed*. Equipped with highly sophisticated communications gear. Employs an experimental targeting system.
